tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rten pa sgo'i gegs sel sgron ma

snang byed bzhugs so/ / skye med mkha' la thugs rje'i sprin 'khrigs pas/ /'gro ba'i nad gso sman pa'i rgyal la 'dud/ /sgo yi gnad las ye shes 'char bas na/ /de yi gegs sel sgron ma gsal byed bri/ /chos nyid 'od gsal gyi dgongs pa ni/ thugs ka dpal gyi be'u'i bum pa na gnas pa las rtsa lam dar dkar gyi skud pa nas/ rgyang zhags chu'i sgron ma gsal ba'i phyir/ sgo'i gnad mig yin pas de bcom pa'i thabs la 'bad par bya ba la gnyis las/ dang po nang gi sman sbyar ba ni/ zla ba phyed pa'i mig sman bstan pa ste/ rtsa a wa/ sngo rtag tu ngu*/ go snyod pa lca ba/ ra mo shag gi rtsa ba rnams zhib par brdungs te/ ba gsar gyi 'o ma phul bcu drug gi nang du thim par gdus la tsha shas che na bzang drug dang*/ grang shas che na bur dkar dang*/ snyoms na seng ldeng dang tsandan dkar dmar drug khyor gang tsam btab nas mdzo mo'am ba gsar gyi zhun mar gyi srang lo grangs tsam du/ bya mo nag mo'i ser sgong sbyar ba'i sman mar thur mgo re tshes bcu drug gi tho rangs bzhin zos pas/ mig gsal zhing 'gribs pa'ang phyed pa yin no/ /phyis mig la nad gang yang mi 'byung ngo*/ /yang rtsa a wa/ rtag tu ngu*/ cong zhi/ brag zhun/ sbrul sngo khra'i sha/ 'bras bu gsum/ dom 'khris/ dre'u'i mkhris pa/ mi'i mkhris pa/ 'ug pa'i mkhris pa/ khyi nag gi mkhris pa/ rta nag gi mkhris pa rnams sman sbrang dang sbyar te ril bu'am/ sman mar sha ril tsam re lto stong la zos na sha'i spyan dang ldan zhing ri brag la sogs pa zang thal du mthong zhing*/ rdo rje lu gu rgyud gsal bar 'gyur ro/ / gnyis pa ni phyi'i sman byug cing*/ sngags dang rten 'brel gyis bcos pa'i thabs la/ sha 'dzer la lto stong la zan dron mar can gyi rlang pas mig la bdugs la/ āoṃ srin long*/ zhes nyer gcig bzlas te khar bcug pas sel lo/ /ling thog la/ gla rtsi/ ka ra/ cu gang*/

zhun thig le rnams rtsi bzhin btags la/ kha mig re tsam gdab cing*/ āoṃ lhing lhing thog thog a tsa li swā hā/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pa'i mchil ma lce rtse na phug ron gyi dang rus blangs la ling thog gi steng du byugs pas/ dkar nyil spris bzhin byung ba phug ron dang rus 'phyag go /mig tu rdul dang gram song na/ āoṃ ya ma dan ting swā hā/ zhes nyer gcig gdab pas phyin no/ /skam tshag dang*/ dmar tshag dang*/ skya rib la/ rag thal dang*/ thod le kor zhib mor byas pa 'o spris dang sbyar te byugs pas sel lo/ /dgong mo nyal dus lte khung du mar gyis mnyes na skam tshag dang mchu rengs pa sel lo/ /go snyod dang gla rtsi chus dgong mo lte khung du byugs na mig gsal zhing*/ gangs la phyin kyang mig phyed par mi 'gyur ro/ /rgyun du nam zhogs lag mthil gnyis kyis mig 'phur nas chu gtsang mar mig la 'debs thabs su khrus byas na/ mig gi sgrib sha bcad cing bkrus pa zhes bya ste/ skya rib mi 'byung zhing gsal lo/ /'o ma dang skyer ba'i khan dha dang*/ gzi rnying nag khra'i phye ma dang*/ bya mo nag mo'i ser sgong bzhi sbyar te/ tshes gcig dang*/ gnam gang dang*/ nya'i tho rangs bzhin dang por chu grang gis mig dang*/ gdong bkrus nas sman byugs te/ 'o skol du shing mngar btab la 'thung na/ mig mi 'grib cing 'od snang gsal bar 'char ro/ /rdo spur lan dang*/ sbrang dkar sbyar te byugs na/ skya rib dang 'gribs pa kun sel lo/ /shel dang*/ thod le kor dang*/ ga pur dang*/ gla rtsi rnams kyi phye ma khye'u nu 'thung gi 'o ma dang sbyar te byugs pas/ 'od snang mched pa rgya cher 'gyur ro/ /rdo smug po sbal rgyab dang*/ rams pa'i rtsa ba dang*/ pu shel rtse dang*/ zhun thig le dang*/ sa ram rtsi dang*/ lcags phye dang*/ ga bur rnams cha mnyam pa rtsi bzhin byas te/ bu khye'u nu 'thung gi 'o ma dang sbyar ba thigs pa re blugs na/

zhag bdun gyi mig 'gṛbs pa kun phyed do/ /ba nag mo'i chu bre gsum gdus pa phul gang du song bar/ gla rtsi/ lcags phyai dom mkhris/ ka ra rnams sbyar te khan dha byas te thigs pa re blugs na 'grib pa dang*/ skya rib thams cad sel bar byed do/ /spyod lam thams cad du drag shul dang*/ mi theg pa 'degs pa dang*/ khams nyams pa rnams spang la/ dgong mo skabs su ltag khung du mar gyis byugs nas mnye ba dang*/ 'o ma skol ba lto stong la gtang pa dang a ru ra rgya gar ma/ go snyod/ rtsa a wa/ rtag tu ngu*/ sbrul sha rnams sbrang dkar chu bcad du sbyar la/ sha ril tsam re lto stong la zos nas khrus byas na/ mig byis pa lo brgyad pa ltar gsal zhing shed skye ba yin no/ /srin bu me khyer dang*/ lhang ma lhang tsher dang*/ bya mo nag mo'i ser sgong bsres pa mig gi steng du byugs la/ āoṃ chen kong chen bhaha na zhu chen zhu/ ha nagha me ston yaṃ/ zhes 'bum bzlas pa na ye shes kyi spyan gsal bas/ 'od snang sna tshogs su 'char zhing*/ 'od skong phor ba tsam 'char bar 'gyur ro/ rdzas med kyang zhal re bzhin brgya rtsa re bzlas na snang ba gong 'phel du 'char ro/ /de ltar sna tshogs zab mo'i thabs mang pos/ /sgron ma gsal byed ye shes gong 'phel ba/ /phyi rabs don du yi ger bkod pa des/ /'gro kun ye shes spyan dang ldan par shog /bla ma las rnyed rang gis myong ba'i gnad/ /'phyugs med lag khrid rab tu gsal ba 'di/ /mngon sum don la blta ba'i grogs yin pas/ /med du mi rung gus pas gces spras gyis/ /rang gzhan sgron ma 'di yis gsal byed cing*/ /myur du 'od gsal dgongs pa mthar phyin 'gyur/ /de bas thabs 'di snying bzhin gces par zung*/ /de ltar bkod pas 'od gsal ches gsal shog /gsang ba snying tig gi gnad las/ /rten pa sgo'i gegs sel/ sgron ma gsal byed ces bya ba/ theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa klong chen rab 'byams kyis bkod pa rdzogs so/
/dge'o/ dge'o/ dge'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (10)rten pa sgo'i gegs sel sgron ma snang byed/ - PAGE 148 - - PAGE 149 -- PAGE 146 -
